main.description: Returns indexed comment counts for a list of subject records, with no authentication required. A comment is an org.hypercerts.context.attachment with contentType "comment" whose subjects include the record; every comment record counts, even several by the same author, and matching uses subjects[].uri, ignoring CID and whether the subject is indexed.

subjects.description: Pass 1–100 full DID-authority subject record AT-URIs as repeated, unbracketed subjects query parameters. The encoded GET request-target must not exceed 7,000 bytes.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The subjects list is empty, has more than 100 entries, exceeds the request-target limit, or contains an invalid subject AT-URI; correct the list and retry.

errors.name: CommentCountQueryFailed
errors.description: The indexed comment count query failed; retry the request.

subject.description: Subject AT-URI requested by the caller; matching ignores the subject CID.

commentCount.description: Number of current indexed comment attachments whose subjects include this URI; zero when none are indexed.

counts.description: One entry for each requested subject, in request order. Repeated input URIs produce repeated entries. Counts reflect current indexed state and may change between requests.
